- [USER] Requested to find the heat transfer rate to the working fluid in the steam generator, thermal efficiency, and rate of heat transfer from working fluid passing through the condenser.

- [ASSISTANT_SAID] State 4: Saturated liquid at 6 kPa and 44.52°C.
